name: brain
description: Amnesia Labs internal alpha. Invite only.
changelog: v0.10.4 — vault reads handle the new vault-key lock (#48). Once a user enrols factor-derived vault keys, Brain can only open their values while the vault key is unlocked in the portal (passkey or recovery key), and a read answers 423 vault_locked with an unlock_url. vault-run and vault-resolve now open that page, poll /vault/unlock/status for up to 120s and retry once, instead of failing (vault-resolve --no-wait exits 2 for hooks that must not block). vault-unlock checks the key after MFA and runs the same unlock if it is locked; --status reports both the loa3 window and the key window. Servers without the feature return 404 on the status route and nothing changes. Also ports a fix that had only reached the beast bundle: the MFA link is printed with a short OSC-8 label (the ~400-char authorize URL used to wrap in an 80-column terminal and lose its PKCE parameters), and a failed browser open is reported with the raw URL instead of being swallowed. The vault skill passes username on vault_drop (plaintext catalog data) and explains the key lock. Prior: v0.10.3 — the research skill no longer assumes the host can run subagents. Many self-hosted setups serve one model request at a time or have no Agent tool, and the skill's large-gap path told the model to spawn 5-8 parallel research agents regardless. It now picks an execution mode per host: parallel only when an Agent/Task tool is actually available, sequential when agents exist but the model server handles one request at a time, and inline (the model researches each facet itself with WebSearch/WebFetch) when there are no agents. Rounds, storage and citations are the same in every mode, and a failing mode drops to the next instead of abandoning the research. Prior: v0.10.2 — the SessionStart update check tells a stale server's 404 apart from an empty plugin store (brain#231).
